description: Connect Right Click Prompt to ChatGPT to manage the authenticated user's prompt library. Review categories, folders, prompt metadata, sharing settings, and one selected prompt's full text; create or update categories, folders, prompts, and private prompt packs; control Quick Access; and create a restricted or public share only when the user explicitly requests it. The connection cannot access another user's library or delete content.

defaultPrompt: Show my RCP categories, their colors, and whether each one appears in Quick Access.
Help me review the titles and usage metadata for prompts in my RCP library without changing anything.
Create a green top-level RCP category named Learning after I confirm the change.
